title: Emergency declaration EM-3629-WA: Flood
summary: FEMA records a emergency declaration (EM-3629-WA, "SEVERE STORMS, STRAIGHT-LINE WINDS, FLOODING, LANDSLIDES, AND MUDSLIDES") for WA, dated 2025-12-12, for an incident of type "Flood". The incident period began on 2025-12-09 and ended on 2025-12-19. The declaration lists 17 designated areas.
